description.text:
The deck that won the Junior Division of the 2019 World Championships. Pikachu & Zekrom-GX decks stood out all season and made up about a quarter of the World Championships field; this one can do 150 damage on its second turn and charge up a GX attack for nearly 400 damage on the next. The 2019 World Championships were held at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, D.C., in August 2019.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2019 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box, a pin and a code card for the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
